LanguageData.VREHT_WeaponAptitude_Randomizer.descript: This will get swapped for a random weapon aptitude gene. It should never be visible to players.
LanguageData.VREHT_WeaponAptitude_Randomizer.label: random weapon aptitude
LanguageData.VREH_Arrogant.description: Carriers of this gene do not have a filter and always say what’s on their mind, even if it rubs the others the wrong way.
LanguageData.VREH_Arrogant.label: arrogant
LanguageData.VREH_BulletproofSkin.description: Carriers of this gene have their skin reinforced by organic kevlar-like strands, allowing them to deflect smaller calliber bullets and only end up with bruises.
LanguageData.VREH_BulletproofSkin.label: bulletproof skin
LanguageData.VREH_ChemicalDependency_Luciferium.descr: Carriers of this gene need to ingest Luciferium on a regular basis to survive. After 10 days without luciferium, carriers will suffer from luciferium deficiency. After 20 days, they will fall into a coma. After 30 days, they will die.
LanguageData.VREH_ChemicalDependency_Luciferium.label: luciferium dependency
LanguageData.VREH_Dutiful.description: Carriers of this gene have a greatly increased sense of duty and will never break down when drafted.
LanguageData.VREH_Dutiful.label: dutiful
LanguageData.VREH_Giant.description: Carriers of this gene are slightly larger than baseline humans.
LanguageData.VREH_Giant.label: giant
LanguageData.VREH_Glidewings.description: Carriers of this gene grow a small set of wings from their shoulderblades. They are not capable of flight, but they will not be slowed down by any obstacles.
LanguageData.VREH_Glidewings.label: glidewings
LanguageData.VREH_Toughness.description: Carriers of this gene have thick skin, dense flesh, and durable bones, and take much less damage than other people from the same blows.
LanguageData.VREH_Toughness.label: toughness
LanguageData.VREH_Unconstrained.description: Carriers of this gene do not suffer movement speed penalties caused by wearing clothing that would normally slow them down.
LanguageData.VREH_Unconstrained.label: unconstrained
